paper.title: Autogenesis: A Self-Evolving Agent Protocol
paper.central_claim: Autogenesis Protocol 把提示、智能体、工具、环境、记忆表示为带版本的注册资源(RSPL)，并以提案-评估-提交(SEPL)统一管理更新，使“演化什么”与“如何提出更新”解耦；其实例系统AGS在推理、工具使用、编码基准上优于其非演化配置，案例展示五类资源共享同一更新生命周期。

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref 未由运行环境提供给 worker；按契约填 null

sections_read: Sec 1-7 (Intro, Related Work, AGP, AGS, Empirical Studies 5.1-5.4, Limitations, Conclusion)
Appendix G.3.5-G.3.7 未评估的扩展草案：读正文说明与算法，公式细节仅浏览（文本中为分行数学符号）
missing_sections: 图中的曲线/案例图像内容（HTML文本中仅有图注）
无关闭自评门控或资源管理层的对照实验（论文自述未做）

evidence.quote: We ask whether heterogeneous resource updates can share one lifecycle while each resource keeps its own execution contract.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者的研究问题/gap：异构资源更新缺少统一生命周期契约

evidence.quote: These methods already retain feedback, candidates, or reusable artifacts. AGP specifies a shared contract for resource identity, candidate evaluation, and versioned commit across resource types.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认最近邻已保留候选/产物；本文差异是跨资源类型的统一契约

evidence.quote: This comparison concerns mechanisms, not matched-budget performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 与TextGrad/MIPRO/GEPA/AFlow/EvoAgentX/Alita仅作机制层比较

evidence.quote: The protocol requires proposal and assessment to leave active resource configurations and bindings unchanged; only accepted commits may publish updates.
evidence.support_explanation: 核心不变式：提案/评估不改动活动配置，仅接受后提交

evidence.quote: For GPQA-Diamond/AIME, evaluation is a separate call to the same backbone, receiving the question and candidate reasoning/answer and returning a satisfaction flag and rationale.
evidence.support_explanation: 推理任务的“评估”是同一骨干的自评，参考答案仅用于最终打分

evidence.quote: a positive self-assessment expresses the evaluator
evidence.support_explanation: 作者明确：自评通过≠正确

evidence.quote: Table entries are single runs; repeated controls are analyzed separately.
evidence.support_explanation: 多模型表为单次运行

evidence.quote: Joint editing is therefore not uniformly preferable, and its benefit should be weighed against inference cost.
evidence.support_explanation: 联合编辑并非处处更优

evidence.quote: Simple Reflection (SR) produces an initial solution and two refinements without persistent resource updates
evidence.support_explanation: 等主要机会的无持久资源更新对照：Simple Reflection

evidence.quote: Across three evaluations, joint editing reaches 59.09% mean accuracy on GPQA-Diamond versus 54.04% for Simple Reflection (351/594 versus 321/594 correct responses).
evidence.support_explanation: 重复评测：GPQA 联合编辑对SR +5.05点

evidence.quote: Gains are 5.05, 2.22, and 3.33 percentage points, with approximately 61%, 57%, and 52% more output tokens than these respective controls.
evidence.support_explanation: 增益伴随约52-61%更多输出token

evidence.quote: Denominators count repeated responses to the same 198 or 30 questions, not additional independent problems.
evidence.support_explanation: 重复评测分母不是独立题目

evidence.quote: These results characterize a higher-accuracy operating point at increased output-token cost, not an equal-compute advantage.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自限：非等算力优势

evidence.quote: single complete evaluations; accuracy and Gain use integer counts before rounding.
evidence.support_explanation: GAIA/多模型结果为单次完整评测

evidence.quote: external systems use their own backbones and budgets
evidence.support_explanation: 外部系统对比非受控

evidence.quote: We report GAIA task-completion accuracy by difficulty and split
evidence.support_explanation: Agent-Evo 与 Vanilla 为同骨干同步数上限的整体系统比较

evidence.quote: The comparison evaluates the complete configured system, including the additional work required to propose and assess edits and execute the updated resources within the stated per-agent step limits.
evidence.support_explanation: 评估包含提案/评估额外工作；未按成本匹配

evidence.quote: Agent-Evo increases reported GAIA validation accuracy from 89.70 to 93.33 and test accuracy from 79.07 to 89.04 within the AGS configuration, and AGS scores 59.6 on HLE.
evidence.support_explanation: GAIA 验证+3.63、测试+9.97；HLE仅报告AGS分数，无无进化对照

evidence.quote: Level 3 shows the largest test increase, from 61.22 to 81.63, but no validation increase, indicating that improvements differ across splits and difficulty levels.
evidence.support_explanation: 难度/划分间不一致

evidence.quote: Solution-Evo permits an initial submission and up to two revisions using online-judge feedback.
evidence.support_explanation: 代码任务使用在线评测反馈修订，最终也由同一评测打分

evidence.quote: Recent release dates do not establish freedom from training contamination, and other backbones are contextual rather than matched-budget controls.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认污染未排除

evidence.quote: This comparison measures the combined effect of feedback-driven revision and additional attempts, rather than an equal-computation advantage.
evidence.support_explanation: 代码结果=反馈修订+额外提交次数

evidence.quote: These gains characterize execution-guided revision within a task.
evidence.support_explanation: 收益是任务内修订，不是跨任务留存

evidence.quote: We do not isolate resource management from the update strategy or establish equal-cost superiority, cross-task transfer, or recovery after faulty activation.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者明示协议本身贡献/跨任务迁移/故障恢复均未验证

evidence.quote: The cases illustrate selected accepted updates, not population-level gains.
evidence.support_explanation: 案例是挑选的已接受更新

evidence.quote: All shown updates are accepted, so the cases do not exercise version rollback.
evidence.support_explanation: 案例未演练回滚

evidence.quote: Total API expenditures are approximately USD 2,000, 6,000, and 200, respectively
evidence.support_explanation: 给出GAIA/HLE/代码的总费用与步数时间，但非变体间匹配成本

evidence.quote: These are aggregate figures, not matched-cost comparisons between variants.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本为聚合值

evidence.quote: The reported target ablations compare what is revised within AGS; they do not isolate resource management while holding the editor, feedback, and realized budget fixed.
evidence.support_explanation: 目标消融不隔离资源管理层

evidence.quote: A satisfaction gate can be wrong and does not enforce true-performance monotonicity.
evidence.support_explanation: 提交门控是满意度自评，可能错误

evidence.quote: Self-evaluation may accept incorrect changes, and external actions may be irreversible.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认自评可能接受错误修改

evidence.quote: It assumes mediated mutations and a trusted registry/version store, covers only captured internal state, and cannot undo completed external actions.
evidence.support_explanation: 恢复的适用条件与边界已明确

evidence.quote: methods reset the item index and collected results, not every resource registry, memory store, or cache.
evidence.support_explanation: 基准重置不清空所有资源注册表/记忆/缓存，跨条目是否复用已提交资源未交代

evidence.quote: SD is the sample standard deviation of three run accuracies, not a confidence interval; each run repeats the same questions.
evidence.support_explanation: 重复为3次、SD非置信区间

evidence.quote: With only three runs per method, these summaries do not characterize population distributions.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认统计有限

evidence.quote: Because the updated policy also adds storage, this is a retrieval result rather than a task-accuracy gain.
evidence.support_explanation: Memory 案例有额外存储混杂，且非任务准确率

evidence.quote: Here, self-evolution refers to feedback-driven edits to resources and task-local solutions rather than model-parameter training.
evidence.support_explanation: 自演化界定为非权重资源和任务内解的编辑

evidence.quote: Our main experiments use reflection, and the alternative adapters remain unevaluated sketches.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅反思式优化器被评估，TextGrad/奖励式适配器未评估

evidence.quote: Repetition captures pipeline sampling and judge variation, not three disjoint datasets.
evidence.support_explanation: 重复含采样与评审者方差

signatures.object: 注册资源（Prompt/Agent/Tool/Environment/Memory 的实现或配置字段，受evolvability标记约束）与任务内解y；基线为同一AGS的非演化配置（Vanilla）
signatures.information: 执行轨迹Z、历史候选评估F；推理任务无参考答案/正确性标签（自评）；代码任务有在线评测判决反馈
signatures.operation: Reflect(轨迹->假设)->Select(限Θ内目标)->Improve(构造候选)->Evaluate(声明的反馈策略)->Commit(接受则记录新版本，拒绝则保持活动绑定)
signatures.output: 新版本的资源记录或更新后的任务内解
signatures.conditions: 至多T次更新迭代；GPQA/AIME最多3次反思；代码最多3次提交
signatures.feedback: 同骨干的满意度自评(is_satisfied+rationale)；代码任务为在线评测裁决
signatures.selection_rule/data: 自评通过即接受（Accept(S)）；无回归测试、无配对反事实、无留出集；拒绝信息回流给下一次反思
signatures.persistence: 版本管理器记录标识与谱系，资源管理器保存配置/产物；可restore到保留版本；发布与消费者绑定是分开的事件
signatures.later_use: 后续派发解析到已接受版本；基准内是否跨条目复用已提交资源未说明（App. D.1暗示注册表未被重置）
signatures.claimed_effect: GPQA/AIME/GAIA/LeetCode 上相对非演化配置的准确率提升；案例展示五类资源的更新与再使用
signatures.failure_boundary: 自评可能接受错误修改；恢复仅覆盖被捕获的内部状态；外部动作不可撤销；回滚/故障激活未演练；跨任务迁移未验证

signatures.object: AGS 的规划者-专家式执行（plan.md+五类专家+Agent Bus+共享记忆）
signatures.operation: 规划者分解并并行/串行派发子任务，收集结果后重新规划
signatures.feedback: not_applicable：静态harness设计，更新只在SEPL触发时发生

gap.author_gap: 异构资源（提示、工具、记忆等）的更新缺乏共享的“识别目标-评估候选-保留已接受版本”的契约，现有通信协议(MCP/A2A)和优化器各自定义提案/搜索与保留状态。
gap.checked_gap: 问题定义清楚但偏接口/工程层：未展示“缺少统一契约”造成的可观察失败或成本；最近邻(TextGrad/MIPRO/GEPA/AFlow/EvoAgentX/Alita)已部分覆盖多资源与保留状态，作者自己也承认。
gap.lineage: Self-Refine/Reflexion -> TextGrad/MIPRO/GEPA -> AFlow/EvoAgentX/Alita（工作流/工具）-> AGP（统一资源与版本化提交契约）；版本取自本文引用与App. E.1
gap.closest_adjacent: EvoAgentX（提示+工具+工作流集成优化）、Alita（可复用工具）、GEPA（候选谱系）；本文做机制比较而非同预算对比
gap.residue: 统一契约相对各优化器各自的状态管理带来什么可测收益；门控质量；跨任务保留收益；回滚有效性
gap.stakes: 长期运行智能体的可审计与可恢复；未量化
gap.method_response: RSPL(资源标识/版本/消费者绑定)+SEPL(提案-评估-提交)+AGS参考实例+三个案例
gap.remaining_gap: 协议层的收益未与更新策略分离；评估门控是自评；无跨任务/回滚验证
unresolved: 2025-26年同类“agent资源版本化/协议”工作未固定，无法核对其新颖性边界

rs_pattern.reason: 把五类异构资源映射到统一的注册记录与统一更新生命周期，取代各资源各自的管理流程；AGS的规划者-专家分工是另一个不同操作，对应分解与派发。

rs_pattern.resolves_note: 提供了统一契约的规格与参考实现，但没有证据表明统一契约本身改善了更新质量、可审计性或恢复。

matches.operation_mapping: Reflect读取轨迹和历史评估、Select限定到可编辑目标、Improve改工具/智能体/环境/提示实现、Evaluate后Commit并版本化，对应“读取轨迹与源码、写补丁、验证后提升/回滚”。

claims.text: AGS 的反思式演化在推理基准上优于 Vanilla（5个骨干）
claims.selection_vs_test: 任务内修订，标签不可见（自评），参考答案仅用于计分；无跨任务留存
claims.result_denominator: 例：GPT-4o GPQA 95->115/198；GPT-4.1 AIME24 7->12/30；Grok AIME24 29/30 全相同；单次运行
claims.counterevidence: AIME每题3.33点、GPT-4.1 GPQA 联合不优于单目标
claims.allowed_conclusion: 带自评门控的任务内多轮修订通常提高这些基准上的单次准确率；增益方向各骨干不同。

claims.text: 联合编辑在等主要机会对照下仍更高（GPT-4o，3次）
claims.baseline_control: SR（无持久资源更新的两次精修）、SC、Bo3
claims.allowed_conclusion: 更高准确率、更高成本的运行点；非等算力优势。

claims.baseline_control: Vanilla（保留初始资源）；外部系统仅作背景
claims.selection_vs_test: 未交代资源编辑是否跨条目保留；反馈来源未逐项说明
claims.result_denominator: 单次完整评测；L3 测试+20.4点而验证0
claims.counterevidence: 额外编辑/评估工作未成本匹配；HLE无无进化对照
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在该配置下Agent-Evo整体系统得分高于Vanilla；增益来源（保留 vs 任务内重试）不可分。

claims.selection_vs_test: 修订使用在线评测裁决，最终也由同一评测计分；污染未排除
claims.result_denominator: 5语言各自计数；修订与额外提交混合
claims.counterevidence: 作者称不是等计算优势

G.reason: 问题（异构资源更新缺少共享生命周期）清楚，最近邻比较表认真，但属接口层缺口，未展示缺少统一契约造成的可观察失败，且EvoAgentX/Alita已部分覆盖。
